mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying clear skies and 60 degree temperatures over Reddan Soccer Park under a full moon. The overnight low will drop to 53 degrees, and we are expecting a dry night with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, please be aware of upcoming construction on Hwy M near the new Aldi site. The road will be closed for final paving from Monday, October 5 through Wednesday, October 7. Traffic will be detoured to Old PB, E Verona Ave, and S Main St, so please allow extra travel time.

You have plenty of local options to fill your schedule. Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, we have trivia nights at Hop Haus and The Bogey Factory, plus the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on September 30.

In a noteworthy report, officers handled an incident on September 5 involving multiple vehicles found with slices of cheese on their windshields. This activity was identified as a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.

Today's flavor is the classic Turtle, which is sure to satisfy your cravings. Culver's is currently open, but they are closing in 43 minutes, so please head out now if you would like to enjoy a treat before they close for the night.
